about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_batch.py). bad replays the GitHub MCP timeout class of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Request timed out line. good batches the read-only calls into one capped dispatch with a timeout, collects them, then prints the batch report it promises.

fixture.log.txt: batch log line covering the collected calls

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out after scattered GitHub calls in owner/name'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath record.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'batch timeout PASS capped'

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out fetching repo records one by one in owner/name'
throw 'Request timed out on mixed read-write dispatch with the writes first in owner/name'
throw 'Request timed out on sequential file-content fetches in owner/name'
throw 'Request timed out retrying the GitHub search singly five times in owner/name'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath record.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'batch timeout PASS variants'

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out fetching several repo records under no timeout in owner/name'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath record.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'batch timeout PASS dispatched'

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out on single-path content fetch with no fallback in owner/name'
throw 'Request timed out on multi-repo search with no cap in owner/name'
throw 'Request timed out with the write before the reads in owner/name'
throw 'Request timed out on license record with API only and no raw fallback in owner/name'
throw 'Request timed out on slow endpoint with unbounded wait in owner/name'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath record.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'batch timeout PASS bounded'

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out on flaky batched call with no recorded outcomes in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath log.txt -Raw; 'RESULT batch PASS collected outcomes'
